description: Extract clean, schema-guaranteed JSON from raw/messy text you already have — scraped web content, email bodies, chat logs, OCR output, or pasted tables. Pass the text in `text`. Use this instead of parse_document when you don't have a file. Optional JSON `schema` (or `schema_id`) constrains the output shape and `instructions` guides extraction. Returns the extracted data plus a confidence score and a review_needed flag. Costs 1 credit per successful call.

instructions.description: Optional natural-language guidance for what to extract.

redact.description: When true, PII (emails, SSNs, card numbers, phones, etc.) is masked in the output before it leaves the server.

schema.description: Optional JSON Schema describing the exact output shape you want. When provided, the returned `data` conforms to it.

schema_id.description: Optional named template to use instead of a hand-written schema, e.g. "invoice", "receipt", "resume". Call the list_schemas tool for the full set. Ignored when `schema` is provided.

text.description: The raw text to extract structured data from.

name: parse_text
title: Parse raw text into structured JSON
